title: Happy Planet
tagline: Happy Planet trains different styles of AI models for artists, and users generate their favorite NFT avatars through smart contracts and drawings.
description: Happy Planet trains original style AI models for artists through stable diffusion. Users can choose different artist styles to purchase avatars in Happy Planet. The avatar will be stored on IPFS as a decentralized NFT. Happy Planet showcases outstanding avatar works and allows users to trade them. Happy Planet also provides users with the token Vendor service. Users can exchange ERC20 tokens through ETH to mint avatars or give them to others.
how_its_made:
• Users: Users connect to the website through their wallets. Upon entering the homepage, a video pops up introducing the project's narrative and providing a brief tutorial, similar to "The Ice-Cream Revolution" in the Heladitos project. Users have the option to watch the video or close the window. After closing the video window, various styles of AI artist models are displayed in the center of the webpage. Users can click on their preferred style to enter and begin uploading their photos for image generation. (The website design prioritizes user convenience and user experience.)

• Artists: After artists log in and link their wallets to the website, they can scroll down to find a page button that allows them to enter a dedicated artist page. By clicking this button, artists can upload their artworks. Upon receiving the submissions, we will screen and evaluate the works. If selected, we will contact the artists and train an AI model for them. The matured models will be displayed on the homepage, available for users to choose, just as mentioned in "1. Users." For every successful sale of an NFT, artists will receive corresponding royalty fees. 

• Token Vendor: This project allows users to purchase AI-generated NFTs directly with ETH or exchange them for our issued ERC20 tokens at a presumed ratio of 1:5. Users can also return the exchanged ERC20 tokens to Token Vendor in exchange for their ETH. To promote the project in its early stages, we plan to conduct a limited ERC20 token airdrop.

• Art Exhibition: On the homepage of the website, there should be a section displaying high-quality NFTs that have been successfully minted and filtered through our backend. This display includes information about the NFT's owner, price, minting time, tokenURI, description, and view count. The purpose of this is to promote the circulation of NFTs within the project, allowing everyone to trade, gift, or showcase their personalized avatars.
